norwegian_host.text: Hei! Velkommen. This church was built in 1868 so that Norwegian sailors in Cardiff had somewhere to worship and a taste of home.
Roald Dahl was baptised here. His parents were Norwegian, and he was born in nearby Llandaff in 1916.
The church was later moved, restored and reopened as an arts centre with a cafe. You can see the bay from the window.

norwegian_fan.text: I have read every Roald Dahl book. I still check my chocolate bars for suspicious golden tickets.
